faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Information Technology Design and Manufacturing, Jabalpur (IIITDM Jabalpur) for a project-based research position in Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIITDM Jabalpur?
faq.answer: IIITDM Jabalpur has advertised for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position under an ANRF-PMECRG sponsored project.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech with M.E./M.Tech or equivalent degree in CSE/IT or a related discipline along with a valid qualified national-level exam such as GATE or NET.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary for the JRF position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA as per the institute norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit to apply for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is set at 35 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application form for the IIITDM Jabalpur JRF recruitment is 05-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. When is the scheduled date for the test or interview?
faq.answer: The test or interview for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to take place on 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q9. How can eligible candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply for the post by filling out the online Google application form provided through the official recruitment link.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates check the official website of IIITDM Jabalpur?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official IIITDM Jabalpur website at https://www.iiitdmj.ac.in to get further updates and detailed official notifications.
